notes.title: Before You Play: Understanding Digs
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I’ve noticed some negative comments from Tower Defense (TD) fans, and I believe there might be some misunderstandings about our game, Digs. I’d like to clarify what you can expect from Digs before you dive in.

As a seasoned Tower Defense player, my goal was to create something fresh and innovative for the genre. However, it seems some of these innovations have been misunderstood by some players.

Digs is a roguelike strategy game with core Tower Defense gameplay featuring “path management.” If you enjoy traditional TD games like Bloons, Kingdom Rush, GemCraft, Cursed Treasure, or Plants vs. Zombies, you'll find familiar mechanics in Digs, but there are significant differences as well. Digs offers unique enemies, towers, and maps, each presenting distinct challenges that allow you to develop your own strategies. Unlike traditional TD games, Digs does not use the same economy model. Additionally, as a roguelike game, every session presents a different map. The maps and paths are not static; you must regularly rearrange them. This is a deliberate design choice, not a flaw. Consequently, you can't replicate your previous layouts or upgrade orders in Digs.

Digs is also not a perfectionist game. Expect to lose health frequently and occasionally win with just one health point left. This is by design. If you seek the perfectionist feeling of traditional TD games, Digs might not be for you. It’s more of a survival game. The early waves are “building waves” where enemies are easier, allowing you to prepare your layout (e.g., creating alternative paths) for the tougher waves ahead. The difficulty ramps up in later waves, requiring you to adjust your defense strategies accordingly. While this approach contrasts with traditional TD games, it is balanced and manageable.

Digs blends elements of TD games with roguelike deckbuilders like Slay the Spire, Peglin, Luck be a Landlord, and Monster Train. It incorporates static deckbuilding and an element of luck, though success is less dependent on luck compared to other roguelike deckbuilders.

If you’re looking for something fresh and enjoy a mix of TD and roguelike deckbuilder genres, you’ll likely enjoy Digs. However, if you expect traditional TD gameplay, you might find it frustrating.

Thank you for playing Digs. Please share your feedback via Discord or Steam discussions. If you enjoy the game, sharing it with others would be incredibly helpful.

Keep digging!

notes.title: Nominate Us for Steam Awards
notes.notes:
Dear Steam Community,

We are excited to share our latest creation with you, Digs, and we believe it's a strong contender for the Innovative Gameplay Award in this year's Steam Awards.

Digs is not just another run-of-the-mill game; it's an experience that pushes the boundaries of traditional gameplay. Our team has poured their heart and soul into crafting an engaging, unique, and truly innovative gaming experience that we believe deserves recognition.

What sets Digs apart is its groundbreaking gameplay mechanics. From the moment you start playing, you'll be immersed in a world that challenges your preconceptions of what a TD game can be. The mechanics, controls, and interactions in our game are unlike anything you've seen before. We've taken a bold step to redefine how players engage with the virtual world, and we're eager to see how it resonates with the gaming community.

We've received incredible feedback from players during our development and beta testing phases, and we've seen firsthand how Digs has captivated and inspired gamers. The innovative features, the seamless integration of technology, and the novel ideas behind the gameplay make us confident that our game is deserving of the Innovative Gameplay Award.

To nominate us, simply visit the Steam Awards page and select Digs in the "Innovative Gameplay Award" category. Your support means the world to us, and your nomination will help us gain the recognition we believe our team deserves.

Thank you for being a part of our gaming journey, and we hope you continue to enjoy Digs as much as we've enjoyed creating it. Together, we can celebrate innovation and push the boundaries of what gaming can achieve.

Warm regards,

Digs Team

notes.title: Digs Premium available on iOS
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! 🎉

We're thrilled to announce that Digs Premium is now live on the App Store! This mobile edition is a fantastic adaptation of the original Digs, with a few enhancements. While the endless mode has been removed, we've optimized the in-game model graphics for a smoother experience.

Our team rigorously tested the game on a range of Apple devices, including the iPhone 7, 11, and 13 Pro Max. We're delighted to report that it runs seamlessly on each of these devices, including iPads.

Please note that, for the time being, Digs Premium is exclusively available on iOS, and we don't have immediate plans for an Android release. However, rest assured that a free-to-play version of the game is in active development, and we'll soon begin testing some exciting prototypes.

Ready to start your digging adventure? Get Digs Premium on the App Store now: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/digs-premium/id6470394694

Keep on digging, and enjoy the game! 🕳️🌟

notes.title: New disaster logic for mysterious blocks and bugfixes
notes.notes:
Greetings,

I'm excited to announce the release of a new update for our game. This update includes several important bug fixes and notable changes that enhance your gaming experience:

Mysterious Stone: In this update, we've modified the behavior of the Mysterious Stone. Now, when it triggers a disaster, it won't immediately lead to the next disaster; instead, it will summon a random one. The subsequent disaster will persist until the wave ends, making "portal manipulation" much more challenging.

Zero Noise Cost Cards: Previously, players with no noise were unable to play cards with zero noise cost due to a bug. We've addressed this issue, and now you can use zero noise cost cards without any hindrance.

Lava and Frost Grounds: Those grounds were blocking the view of Crystals. We've resolved this problem, ensuring a clearer view of the crystals.

Enemy Healing: Lava and Frost Grounds were not effectively healing the related type enemies. With this update, they will now fully heal these enemies, increasing the difficulty of magma and frozen levels.

Upgrade Screen: Previously, when your card deck became crowded on the upgrades screen, it would block access to other buttons. This issue has been fixed, allowing for smoother navigation on the upgrades screen.

New Enemy Addition: We've introduced a new enemy to the game. You may have noticed an achievement related to "Chesty" without encountering them. With this update, we've added a new level featuring Chesty, so now you can earn that achievement on the latest level.

This update represents our final round of bug fixes, and we are confident that it addresses all reported issues. However, if you happen to encounter any more bugs or have feedback to share, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on our Discord channel: https://discord.gg/2pwFk6HRCh.

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy this latest update.

Keep digging

notes.title: New translations and fixes
notes.notes:
Hello,

I'm excited to announce our latest update, which brings a host of improvements to the game. Here's a rundown of what's new:

Enhanced Translations: We've added new translations for various in-game elements, including upgrades, towers, and more. While some may still have minor errors, we're actively working on fixing them in upcoming updates. If you'd like to contribute and help us improve the translations, please consider joining our Discord community. https://discord.gg/2pwFk6HRCh

Translation Quality Assurance: The Russian translation has been meticulously checked by "YouG1N," ensuring accuracy. Our dedicated community members are currently reviewing the Portuguese, German, and Italian translations, and we'll incorporate them into the game once they are complete.

Orb Stones Boost: We've increased the effectiveness of the new orb stones, giving them a 20% boost to make your gameplay even more exciting.

Balancing Act: To maintain game balance, we've significantly reduced flame damage, ensuring a fair and enjoyable gaming experience.

Improved User Experience: You'll now see the level name and a brief description of the challenge when selecting a game mode, making it easier to choose the right level for your skill and strategy.

Crystal Tower Fix: Crystal type towers were occasionally missing small, speedy, or armored enemies. We've resolved this issue to make your tower defense more effective.

Narrative Adjustments: We've removed Warf's sad story from the game. We believe that the current climate is challenging enough, and we don't want to bring down the morale of our players.

Early Access Update: We've removed the opening message about early access. Even though we're still in early access, the final game will be released in just two weeks. Rest assured, our support and regular updates will continue beyond the official launch.

Keep digging!!

notes.title: Update: dig probability removed
notes.notes:
Hi,

We've published a new update for Digs, and in this update, there is a major change in gameplay. Now, the "dig chance" for every block is 100%, so you will never miss on your digs. However, we've adjusted the spawn rates for important blocks (crystal, orb, trap, card, mysterious blocks), and they will now appear less frequently.

In terms of probability calculations, the game difficulty remains the same in Extreme mode. However, in Hard mode, you will receive approximately 15% more resources, and in Normal mode, you'll get 30% more resources compared to the previous gameplay. In Extreme mode, the probabilities remain almost the same.

Additionally, we've reduced the difficulty for the first 6 levels. Levels 1-3 are now 20% easier, and levels 4-6 are 10% easier than the rest.

Mysterious blocks will now yield 66% disasters and 33% card rewards.

We've made some changes to certain upgrades. The range upgrade for traps, which was introduced in the recent build, has been removed. Dig chance upgrades have also been removed, as well as the disasters related to no dig chance.

Since these are significant changes to the gameplay, we would greatly appreciate any feedback you might have. Please feel free to share your thoughts with us.

Keep digging!!

notes.title: New update
notes.notes:
Hey there,

We've just released a new update packed with exciting features:

We've added 6 new levels, which are currently labeled as "beta" since they haven't undergone extensive testing. These fresh levels introduce a range of blocky challenges that are sure to keep you entertained 🙂

Introducing a unique addition to our starting deck – the "gem" card. This card guarantees you an extra gem, even in cases where you might lose or decide to exit a level. Classified as "very rare," this card could prove to be a valuable asset for gem farming.

Our latest enhancement is the revamped Upgrade Screen. Now equipped with 5 distinct tabs, it provides a much smoother navigation experience. We've also incorporated a new information panel for upgrades, delivering more comprehensive details about each upgrade's benefits.

Our upgraded upgrade system brings a change: some upgrades are initially locked and only become accessible after triumphing over specific levels or modes. We've streamlined the upgrade tiers by removing some extras that had the potential to disrupt the game's balance.

Responding to player feedback, we've temporarily removed the Tunneler Boss due to identified bugs. We're committed to rectifying these issues and will reintroduce the Tunneler Boss once they're resolved.

Bug alert! We've successfully fixed the bug related to noise reduction/halved disasters.

For those who crave speed, you'll be thrilled to know that we've doubled the spinning speed of the Lazer.

We've revamped the color schemes of blocks for crystals, orbs, and traps. These blocks are now much more easily identifiable, enhancing your gameplay experience.

Join us in celebrating the start of the Steam Strategy Festival, featuring an exclusive 30% discount on bundles. Now is your chance to grab the Digs and Digs Icy bundle at this limited-time price.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34088/Digs_Bundle/



Keep digging!!

notes.title: Digs-dev plays
notes.notes:
"Digs" is an exciting and challenging roguelike tower defense game that offers endless possibilities and a new experience every time you play. As the defender, your task is to protect a valuable chest from waves of enemies on a randomly generated map. Using strategy and quick thinking, you must dig in the mine and place towers, traps, and obstacles to defend the chest. Each stone block holds various rewards, such as towers, power-ups, and more. Use cards earned at the beginning of each wave to customize and upgrade your towers, giving you the edge you need to defeat the enemies and progress to the next level.
The final release will include dozens of different towers, each with unique abilities for crushing more enemies.

notes.title: improvement and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

We've published an update for some bug fixes and improvements, but please note that this update only applies to the demo version. We are no longer updating the Prologue version. https://store.steampowered.com/app/2281870/Digs/

In this update, we've introduced a new enemy leveling system and spawn logic. Now, every wave, enemies level up, and the "get buff" disaster only levels up the enemy. Currently, leveling up means a 10% increase in HP for the enemy, but in the future, we can implement other types of increases like speed, armor, etc. Additionally, you can now see the enemies' HP and levels on the enemy icon when you hover over it.

We've also removed the fast forward option as it wasn't working well. However, with the new enemy leveling system, the waves can be shortened dramatically, so we won't need the fast forward button anymore.

Furthermore, we've fixed the bug with the settings panel language icon and added the display of the American flag.

Lastly, the sound is now adjusted when the game opens, and we've made some English language fixes (although some of them still exist).


Keep digging!

notes.title: Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

For the past two weeks, we haven't been able to release any updates because we were working on a major update, and now we can finally make the announcement.

Our demo is live! You can download the demo from the game's page at https://store.steampowered.com/app/2281870/Digs/


We have added new features to the demo.

Now the game has four different difficulty levels for each level: Easy, Normal, Hard, and Endless. The number of waves increases gradually for each level, and the enemies become much stronger.

We have added a leaderboard for each level in the game. You can see your scores on the leaderboard in the Endless game mode. To be able to view the leaderboard, you need to have completed the game on Hard difficulty.

We have introduced a Twitch mode to the game. In this mode, your viewers on Twitch can choose the disasters that will occur during your gameplay. If you want an interactive and challenging experience, we recommend giving it a try.

We have added 13 new disasters to the game. Currently, these disasters only appear in Twitch mode. However, in the full game, you will see new levels that include these and additional disasters that we will add.

We have added a fast forward button to the game. Now you can adjust the game speed to 1x, 1.5x, 2x, or 4x. This way, you have the opportunity to shorten long waves.

We have made several improvements to the demo.

The chances of rare cards appearing have been increased. Normal cards have a 50% chance, rare cards have a 30% chance, very rare cards have a 15% chance, and legendary cards have a 5% chance of appearing.

We have fixed a few bugs in the demo.

The issue where unpurchased cards could be mistakenly bought has been resolved.
Frank no longer gets stuck when he becomes a professor.
The save problem between versions has been fixed.
The issue with the Q and E keys affecting camera height has been resolved.


Keep digging!
